This is a simple example of doing leave-future-out cross validation.

```{r}
data(grey_seal_data)

elpd_lfo_out <- c()
for (year in 2010:2023) {

  fit <- fit_ipm(
    grey_seal_data,
    "grey",
    years = 2005:(year - 1),
 #   iter_warmup = 100,
 #   iter_sampling = 100
method = "pathfinder"
  )

forecast <- forecast_ipm(
     fit,
    grey_seal_data,
     future_years = year
  )

  year_elpd_lfo <- sealIPM:::elpd_lfo(forecast)
  elpd_lfo_out <- c(elpd_lfo_out, year_elpd_lfo)
}
```
